long_description:
✨ Pujo Vibes are Loading in Mountain House! ✨

🪘 Poorba’s Durga Puja is turning 5! 🪘

Can you believe it? It’s our 5th milestone year, and we are ready to make it bigger, brighter, and more magical than ever. From the rhythmic beats of the Dhak and delicious bhog to spectacular cultural performances—this is where your heart belongs this October.

But wait... we are kicking off the celebrations with an absolute bang! 🎉

🪩 October 16th: DISCO DANDIYA NIGHT! 

Get ready to light up the dance floor! We are mixing tradition with high-energy beats for a night you won't forget.

• The Beats: Non-stop, foot-tapping tracks to keep you moving.

• The Lights: A dazzling, high-energy atmosphere.

• The Vibe: Music, dance, and pure celebration!

Grab your Dandiya sticks, put on your most colorful outfits, and let’s dance the night away!

📅 Event Details:

• When: October 16th – October 18th (Disco Dandiya on Oct 16!)

• Where: Central Park, Mountain House

Whether you’re here for the rituals, the food, the Disco Dandiya, or just the irreplaceable festive nostalgia, there is a place for everyone in the Poorba family.

Bring your family, bring your friends, and let’s make our 5th year absolutely unforgettable!

👉 Stay tuned for registration details, schedule, and cultural lineup announcements coming soon! 

Also check out other Parties in Mountain House, Entertainment events in Mountain House.
street_address: 25 Main St (corner of Central Pkwy & Main St),Mountain House, California
